before_results.readmission: A positive means returning to the hospital within 30 days of discharge. Missing a positive matters more than a false alarm because the patient could miss a follow-up call or extra support after going home.
before_results.diabetes: A positive means the adult reports a doctor's diagnosis of diabetes or has an HbA1c of 6.5% or higher. Missing a positive matters more than a false alarm because a false alarm can lead to an extra test, while a missed case can mean losing the chance to follow up with someone who may need it.
